name: stillwatch-monorepo
description: Stillwatch: a local flight recorder for coding agents.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @stillwatch/web run build && pnpm --filter stillwatch run build
scripts.test: vitest run --project node --project web && vitest run --project perf
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.lab: pnpm --filter stillwatch run build && node apps/cli/dist/stillwatch.mjs lab
scripts.benchmark: pnpm --filter stillwatch run build && node apps/cli/dist/stillwatch.mjs lab --benchmark
